issue_deck: Week 9 delivers a monument to managerial self-inflicted wounds, led by The Big Gronkowski leaving 26.92 points on the pine during a microscopic 0.80-point defeat.

lead_story.headline: THE ART OF LEAVING A WIN ON THE BENCH
body: Week 9 will be archived as a museum of managerial malpractice, headlined most violently by The Big Gronkowski. Managing a roster is apparently a delicate art form, especially when 26.92 points sit comfortably on the bench while a razor-thin 0.80-point loss to Patty Primetimes unfolds. A properly optimized lineup would have turned a heartbreaking defeat into a comfortable 26.12-point victory. Instead, anchoring starters like Drake Maye, Malik Nabers, and Harrison Butker while keeping Jordan Love, Xavier Worthy, and Spencer Shrader locked in reserve proved to be an expensive exercise in stubbornness.

Not to be outdone in the architecture of self-inflicted wounds, ThreatLevelMidnight and Malle ❤️ 🐸 also joined the exclusive club of managers who could have rewritten their weekend fates. ThreatLevelMidnight left 7.50 points unplayed, missing out on a 6.00-point win over Ginger FC 🏆🏆 during a 1.50-point thriller, while Malle ❤️ 🐸 left 6.20 points behind in a 6.00-point setback against Pop Lockett Drop it. In a league of razor-thin margins, the bench is becoming less of a safety net and more of a permanent parking garage for trophies.

matchup_recaps.headline: A Sub-Point Escape Act
matchup_recaps.body: Patty Primetimes survived a 123.46 to 122.66 thriller against The Big Gronkowski by the slimmest of margins—a mere 0.80 points. Entering the week with a 3-4-0 historical H2H record against The Big Gronkowski, Patty Primetimes dodged a massive bullet as the opponent left 26.92 points on the bench.

matchup_recaps.headline: One and a Half Points of Survival
matchup_recaps.body: Ginger FC 🏆🏆 posted the week's high score of 125.44 points, but needed every single one of them to fend off ThreatLevelMidnight's 123.94. ThreatLevelMidnight entered the week holding an 8-4-0 historical edge in the series, but a 1.50-point margin went the other way despite 7.50 points resting on the loser's bench.

matchup_recaps.headline: Six-Point Separation in a Squeeze
matchup_recaps.body: Pop Lockett Drop it snapped a two-game losing skid by defeating Malle ❤️ 🐸 117.20 to 111.20. Pop Lockett Drop it carried a 7-3-0 historical H2H lead into the contest and converted it into a win, while Malle ❤️ 🐸 lamented 6.20 bench points that could have flipped the 6.00-point final.

matchup_recaps.headline: Sub-100 Grit Gets It Done
matchup_recaps.body: Voldemort secured a 98.58 to 86.00 victory over Buttermilk Puuump, building on a 2-1-0 historical H2H advantage entering the matchup. Efficiency wasn't pretty, but it proved sufficient against a struggling Buttermilk Puuump side.

matchup_recaps.headline: A Thirty-Eight Point Verdict
matchup_recaps.body: Joe Mantegna cruised past Uncle Rico with a comfortable 104.88 to 66.82 blowout. Uncle Rico entered the weekend holding a 7-4-0 historical edge in the series, but added another chapter to a brutal campaign while pushing career losses to a milestone 75.

matchup_recaps.headline: The Forty-Two Point Rout
matchup_recaps.body: Post Mahomes authored the week's biggest blowout, dismantling malle_dips_pouches 110.68 to 68.50. Holding a 7-3-0 historical H2H record entering the week, Post Mahomes had little trouble extending dominance over an opponent whose lineup efficiency stalled out at 80.4%.

managerial_desk.headline: The 26.92-Point Monument to Bench Auditing
managerial_desk.body: The Big Gronkowski earned the dubious distinction of orchestrating the worst managerial decision of the week, leaving 26.92 points on the pine during an 82.0% efficiency outing. Locking Jordan Love, Spencer Shrader, and Xavier Worthy on the bench while trusting Drake Maye, Harrison Butker, and Malik Nabers turned a projected 26.12-point win into a 0.80-point defeat. Uncle Rico also contributed to the clinic, stranding 17.6 points on the bench with a 79.15% efficiency rate, while Pop Lockett Drop it left 17.44 points unused.

luck_report.headline: Brutal Beats and Fortunate Padding
luck_report.body: ThreatLevelMidnight suffered the week's most brutal beat, putting up the second-highest weekly score of 123.94 points only to run into Ginger FC 🏆🏆 and absorb a 1.50-point loss, supported by an elite 0.9091 expected win rate and 10 all-play wins. The Big Gronkowski also endured a harsh reality check with an 0.7273 expected win rate and 8 all-play wins in a narrow defeat. On the other side of the ledger, Voldemort, Joe Mantegna, and Post Mahomes collected fortunate victories, winning despite lower all-play profiles and expected win rates under 0.46.

record_book.headline: Milestones and Narrow Brackets
record_book.body: Patty Primetimes came within 0.74 points of setting the league record for the narrowest win, settling for a 0.80-point margin against The Big Gronkowski just behind the all-time mark of 0.06. Meanwhile, Uncle Rico reached a milestone nobody rushes to celebrate, notching career loss number 75.

next_week.headline: Week 10 Previews: History Meets the Projections

previews.headline: History Chases the Model
previews.body: Post Mahomes holds a 7-4-0 historical H2H edge over The Big Gronkowski across 11 prior meetings, totaling 1273.7 points against 1150.64. Despite that historical advantage, the projection model favors The Big Gronkowski at 119.25 to 93.69.

previews.headline: Even Series Collides With a Heavy Favorite
previews.body: The historical series between Malle ❤️ 🐸 and ThreatLevelMidnight sits at an even 5-5-0 across 10 games, with ThreatLevelMidnight holding a 1110.32 to 1060.38 scoring edge. Projections heavily favor ThreatLevelMidnight at 115.14 to 72.43.

previews.headline: A Lopsided History Defies the Forecast
previews.body: Voldemort commands a 6-1-0 historical H2H record against Patty Primetimes over 7 meetings, outscoring them 805.52 to 660.50. However, the projection model reverses expectations entirely, slating Patty Primetimes at 120.52 to Voldemort's 58.75.

previews.headline: Familiar Foes Battle for Position
previews.body: Joe Mantegna holds a 6-4-0 historical H2H edge over Ginger FC 🏆🏆 across 10 matchups, leading 1025.74 to 979.96 in total points. Projections keep it competitive, giving Joe Mantegna holds a 6-4-0 historical edge at 111.39 to Joe Mantegna's 101.82.

previews.headline: Dead-Even Ground Up For Grabs
previews.body: Pop Lockett Drop it and malle_dips_pouches stand dead even historically at 6-6-0 across 12 prior games, with malle_dips_pouches holding a razor-thin 1285.32 to 1276.06 points advantage. The projection model gives Pop Lockett Drop it the edge at 115.63 to 104.74.

previews.headline: Uncle Rico Protects a Perfect Mark
previews.body: Uncle Rico maintains a flawless 4-0-0 historical H2H record against Buttermilk Puuump, outscoring them 462.04 to 337.50. Projections reinforce that edge, slating Uncle Rico at 79.76 to 55.24.

closing_shot: When 26.92 points sit quietly on your bench during a 0.80-point loss, you aren't just managing a fantasy roster—you're curating a museum of regret.
